_comment: Plain stdio MCP config for the GeoLens read-only server: the {command, args, env} shape most MCP clients accept as-is. As written it points at the public demo instance and needs no credentials. For your own instance, change GEOLENS_INSTANCE and add "GEOLENS_API_KEY": "your-api-key" to the env block. See ../README.md and the other files in this directory for client-specific config paths and quirks, and https://docs.getgeolens.com/guides/sdk/mcp/ for the tool reference.
